characters.name: Aase Gaasepige
characters.description: Aase is the bride in a royal wedding setting. She wears traditional and lavish wedding attire typical of a princess, featuring elegant fabrics and intricate embroidery. Her hair is styled elaborately beneath a delicate veil, enhancing her regal appearance. The setting is a vibrant celebration with noble guests and opulent decorations.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: This is a clever young boy depicted on a country road, holding a nut that contains the devil. He is curious and mischievous, dressed in simple 19th-century peasant attire, with a determined look on his face as he triumphs over the devil.

characters.name: Fanden
characters.description: The devil in this story is elusive and can change size. Not directly visible, he is represented inside a nut held by the boy. His presence is implied rather than explicit, adding a whimsical and mythical tension to the scene.

characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: A robust and muscular blacksmith, portrayed in the intense act of trying to open a nut with various hammers. He wears traditional blacksmith clothing—thick apron, goggles perched above his brow—and stands in a forge filled with the tools of his trade, showcasing a determined and powerful demeanor.

characters.name: Folernes mægtige mand
characters.description: An authoritative figure, likely the king standing on his castle's steps, wearing regal clothing and a crown, exuding a sense of command and enquiry. His attire is regal, with rich fabrics and embellishments befitting a king in a fairytale setting.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young boy known for his laziness, typically lying by the fireplace covered in ash. He is depicted with messy hair, wearing tattered and simple clothes, his demeanor relaxed and unbothered by the world outside, embodying the classic theme of the underestimated underdog.
